IdealPlayer 1.2.9 (versionCode 43)

IdealPlayer's original application source retains its MIT license. The distributed
application also incorporates GPL/LGPL and permissively licensed components. The
combined full-feature build is distributed under GNU GPL version 3; individual
components retain their own copyright notices and license options. This statement
does not relicense upstream code or remove rights granted by the MIT license.

Copyright/license texts and artifact identities are in component-notices/index.json
and native-notices/index.json. Both indexes reference the original text files by
SHA-256. The native inventory conservatively retains some build-only notices too.
The upstream LibVLC Maven LGPL declaration does not describe every statically
linked component in this full GPL-enabled VLC build. Jellyfin FFmpeg is retained.

Corresponding source distribution location:
https://github.com/meliherenn/IdealPlayer/releases
Select the source archive for versionCode 43 / 1.2.9 and its checksum manifest.
The archive includes application sources, native upstream archives, all local
patches, component/build configurations and build/install instructions. Signing
keys, personal account data and local configuration are not distributed. Use your
own signing key to build/install a modified copy. No signature-based restriction
has been added to the application's playback or other functionality.

The source archive must be publicly available before this binary is distributed,
and remain available while this binary is distributed. A local staging archive
alone does not fulfill this condition. No warranty is provided; see license texts.
